## What is this about?

<!-- generated by aider + aider-skills + skill create-blog-entry-what-is-this-about -->

The qf-fx-gui-lib-telemetry library adds OpenTelemetry instrumentation to the QFTest FX GUI Library, allowing developers to measure performance of both server‑side and client‑side operations. It defines five measurement points—resolver lookup, agent command round‑trip, FX queue wait, event dispatch, and verification wait—and correlates spans across JVMs using a custom step ID attribute. The library works with standard OpenTelemetry exporters such as Jaeger, requiring only a simple initialization call in the server and client JVMs. Test engineers and developers who need detailed latency insights can start by adding the jar to their project and invoking ServerTelemetry.init() and ClientTelemetry.init() in their test setup.
